name: Glass Block
description: A wall of pressed glass blocks, each pillowed face rippled with concentric rings and lit unevenly from behind.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2)); -webkit-clip-path: inset(3.5% round 7%); clip-path: inset(3.5% round 7%); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 12%; border-radius: 9%; background: @p(var(--color3), var(--color4)); opacity: @rn(.35, 1); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 12%; border-radius: 9%; background: @p(var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: repeating-radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, #000 0 7%, transparent 7% 14%); mask: repeating-radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, #000 0 7%, transparent 7% 14%); opacity: .55; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
